primary_comparison.skill: the only assigned difference is normal native visibility of the pinned Repoctx skill
primary_comparison.estimand: incremental effect of exposing the pinned skill when the same Repoctx executable is available in both conditions

sample.incomplete_pairs: retain attempts and costs; classify the aggregate as inconclusive when missing pairs exceed 5 percent

randomization.pairing: run both conditions for the same task and repeat in adjacent slots
randomization.workspace: fresh source export and writable scratch for every trial

cache_and_setup.repoctx_index: start empty in both primary conditions; an agent-triggered compile remains in that trial's measured cost
cache_and_setup.provider_cache: interleave pairs; record input, cached-input, output, and reasoning usage when available; use null when unavailable
cache_and_setup.os_cache: record observed state when available; otherwise mark unknown
cache_and_setup.binary_build: pin and hash the executable; report build time and resource use as setup cost
cache_and_setup.prefill_or_prebuilt_index: evaluate in a separate comparison with skill visibility held fixed; report evidence-prefill and index-preparation costs separately

uncertainty.repeated_trials: retain all three repeats inside each task cluster

analysis.decision_rule: use the M4-05 quality guard and metric-specific efficiency thresholds; report each metric, classify incomplete or crossing intervals as inconclusive, and make no benefit claim if the quality guard fails
analysis.failures_and_timeouts: count as task failures and retain measured cost
analysis.setup_cost: report separately and show all-in cost at declared deployment volumes; do not omit compilation or evidence/index preparation
